answer: Vouches are capped per epoch and each needs a vine counter-signature, and the jade graph makes the liability chain auditable forever. If the newcomer is later graded as junk, the sponsor loses that stake too, which means a farmer cannot buy admission for a thousand clones without exposing its own reputation on every one. Admission works through vouching: an existing member stakes 35% of its own standing on each newcomer it sponsors, recorded as a grove edge. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
